summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Sanjeev Mill Udhyog Khata app. Backend: 37 pytest cases (auth, auth-guards on all 10 protected routes, customer CRUD, ledger charges/payments, validation, entry update/delete, cascade delete, dashboard stats, token isolation) — 37/37 pass. Frontend: complete owner journey verified on the public preview URL — wrong-password error, login redirect, localStorage token, session persistence on reload, 4 dashboard KPIs with Rs. formatting, top-debtor row + Open link navigation, customer create/search(name+phone)/edit/delete with confirm, charge amount preview (4 x 250 = Rs. 1,000.00), payment entry + running-due math, payment<=0 validation, single-entry delete with recompute, print ledger page (company header, customer info, rows, totals, auto window.print, zero buttons/nav inside .print-area), logout clearing token, and unauthenticated redirect to /login. No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS="*" is used together with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject wildcard origin with credentials; works today only because auth uses a Bearer header, not cookies. Set explicit origin(s).
No brute-force / rate-limit lockout — unlimited failed login attempts are accepted (verified repeated 401s with no throttling).

get_current_user reads an 'access_token' cookie, but /api/auth/login never sets one and /api/auth/logout does not clear one — dead code path. Either implement httpOnly cookie auth or remove the cookie branch.
Create returns 200 instead of 201 Created (cosmetic REST nit).
Uses exclude_none, so a field can never be cleared back to empty via the API (e.g. removing a photo/address).
photo base64 field has no size limit — a large image can bloat the document / hit the 16MB BSON cap.

ui_bugs.issue: After successfully recording a payment, load() remounts AddEntries and the tab silently resets to 'Add Product / Credit'. A user entering several payments must re-click 'Record Payment' each time (also caused a test-flow failure on the first run).
load() sets loading=true on every refresh, so the entire page is replaced by a 'Loading…' string after each add/delete — full-page flicker instead of an inline/table-level loader.

issues: 'Remaining Due' total value wraps onto two lines ('Rs.' / '1,000.00') because the totals column is only 1/3 width with the label beside it — use whitespace-nowrap or a wider column; this appears on the printed PDF.
Print ledger table rows have no cell padding or row separators, so rows look cramped compared with the in-app table.
'OPEN →' action link wraps onto two lines in its column at 1920px width.
Horizontal overflow: document scrollWidth is 395px vs 390px viewport; the row delete (trash) button is clipped at the right edge.

Date fields use the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy chrome picker) rather than a styled shadcn calendar — inconsistent with the rest of the ledger styling and shows US format on a Nepali-locale app.

action_items: Preserve the selected tab (charge/payment) in CustomerDetail after a successful entry submit instead of resetting to 'Add Product / Credit'.
Fix 'Remaining Due' wrapping on the print ledger totals block (whitespace-nowrap / wider column).
Replace CORS_ORIGINS="*" with the explicit preview origin since allow_credentials=True.
Fix 5px horizontal overflow on the customer list at 390px (clipped delete button).
Optional: avoid full-page 'Loading…' replacement on CustomerDetail refresh; use an inline loader.
critical_code_review_comments: _due_for_customer() is called once per customer inside GET /api/customers and /api/dashboard/stats (N+1 query pattern). Replace with a single $group aggregation on db.entries to avoid O(N) round-trips as the customer base grows.
PATCH /api/entries/{id} accepts a raw 'amount' for charge entries without recomputing from qty*rate, allowing an amount that contradicts quantity*rate. Ignore client-supplied amount for charges.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is an invalid/ignored combination per the CORS spec.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login — add attempt throttling/lockout.
Dead cookie branch in get_current_user (no endpoint ever sets or clears 'access_token' cookie).
ledger running-balance computation is duplicated verbatim in CustomerDetail.jsx (computeLedger) and PrintLedger.jsx — extract into a shared helper (DRY).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed; 2 UI nits + 4 design issues reported

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_ prefixed customers (TEST_Ram Bahadur, TEST_Ledger Cust, TEST_Cascade, TEST_QA Gopal) and their ledger entries. DB left clean: only the pre-existing demo customer 'Ram Bahadur Thapa' (Rs. 2,550.00 due) and the seeded admin remain.
test_credentials: owner@sanjeevmill.com / Sanjeev@2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — valid, admin bcrypt hash verified as $2b$ 60 chars; seed_admin correctly resets password when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v). It runs under xdist parallelism, so the dashboard total_customers assertion uses a 3x retry to avoid cross-worker races. Frontend flows fully covered via Playwright against https://khata-pro-24.preview.emergentagent.com; the print page auto-calls window.print(), so stub it with page.add_init_script('window.print = () => {}') before navigating. Remaining unverified: customer photo base64 upload path and multi-owner isolation (only one user exists in the system).
rca_of_the_issue: Tab reset after payment: CustomerDetail.load() flips loading=true, unmounting <AddEntries/>; its local useState('charge') re-initialises on remount, discarding the user's 'payment' tab selection. Fix by lifting the tab state above the loading guard or not blanking the page during refetch. Print 'Remaining Due' wrap: the totals grid gives the block only 1/3 of a max-w-4xl container while label+value share one flex row, so the Rs. value has insufficient inline width.
